document: Morocco RPS 2000 version 2011, annex to Decree 2-12-682
publication: Bulletin Officiel no. 6206, French official translation, 21 November 2013
official_host: Agence Urbaine de Tétouan, government-hosted official gazette reproduction
edition_note: Fixed historical edition. This is not a claim about the consolidated regulation in force.
author: Benchmark author; no independent review
conditions_protocol: The drafter receives source clauses and source contexts only. Gold interpretations, scope facts, scenarios and labels are withheld. Conditions must be extracted from the source. Unknown project conditions must produce evidence requests.
general_case_scope: Unless a case explicitly states otherwise, a new ordinary building covered by the source's section 1.2. This fact belongs to evaluation project evidence and is not included in drafting prompts.
inventory_protocol: A satisfying universal fixture has a complete inventory only when explicitly stated. A confirmed counterexample can establish violation with incomplete inventory.
attestations: Any future reviewer evidence in these scenarios is synthetic.
